posts.text: Cam Heyward looks forward to the Browns game on Sunday: “I know they've gotten on a roll. You know, they beat us. They beat Baltimore as well. posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Cam Heyward opens up about Aaron Rodgers: “Aaron prepares as soon as that game's done onto the next game. And we feel it throughout the week. He's asking the right questions. He's always challenging players. He's always making sure the offense feels like it's up to speed. And so when he's checking plays and he's making sure everybody's accountable, you feel as comfortable as you can. You feel like he's gonna lead you to the right destination, just because he is prepared. He is a student of the game. A lot of times we talk about being a teacher to the young guys, but he's always trying to find things that are nuanced and that work. And when you got a guy that can still throw as fast as he does and throw as long as he does, he's gonna put you in the right direction.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Todd Haley details on 93.7 The Fan how the Steelers can win playoff games: “What has to happen in my view for the Steelers if we're talking winning playoff games is they have to make plays on the outside. I told you guys this a few weeks ago. I mean, they made the scramble play to DK—great play by him, great throw by Aaron using his feet. But I think that's the key. I loved running the football on all those third-and-shorts. That was awesome. Those are backbreakers for the defense. When you're converting a third-and-four or five running the football, those are killers. But who is this outside guy that can make those plays when teams say, 'Hey, we're not going to allow you to run it'? We saw it two nights ago with Seattle. They said, 'We're not going to let Kenneth Walker beat us.' And all of a sudden, Kansas City got exposed a little bit because there was nobody on the outside winning. And that's my biggest concern with the Steelers right now.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: kimberleymartin.bsky.social
posts.text:
Matt Eberflus at 9:30a: “I’m confident I’ll be prepping for SF and coaching this team.”

Matt Eberflus at noon: FIRED.

(Why would the #Bears let that man address reporters, knowing he wouldn’t make it thru the week, let alone the day?)

irregularities.title: bluesky was not reachable on this run
irregularities.detail: Probe of https://public.api.bsky.app/xrpc/app.bsky.feed.searchPosts?q=nfl%20injury&limit=1&sort=latest returned status=403 (HTTP 403 Forbidden). The adapter was SKIPPED rather than retried, so this run has no posts from that platform. app.bsky.feed.searchPosts is HTTP 403 for this project (re-measured 2026-09-18 from the CI runner and from an independent client IP). Unauthenticated Bluesky search is therefore unavailable; discovery comes from Google News and from the verified handles this project follows directly (app.bsky.feed.getAuthorFeed, which does work).

irregularities.title: reddit was not reachable on this run
irregularities.detail: Probe of https://www.reddit.com/r/NFL_Discussion/about.json?raw_json=1 returned status=403 (HTTP 403 Blocked). The adapter was SKIPPED rather than retried, so this run has no posts from that platform. Reddit's public JSON endpoints have contested availability in 2026 (some reports say ~60 req/min unauthenticated, others say broadly blocked with 403 since May 2026), so an unreachable probe here is expected and is not treated as a pipeline failure.
